faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about pricing, providers, and launching your workloads on the Fluence GPU fabric.

items.question: How does deterministic pricing work?
items.answer: Every GPU SKU has a fixed hourly rate regardless of utilization. Billing is per-minute and you only pay for successful compute time.

items.question: What providers power the network?
items.answer: We aggregate vetted data centers and independent operators that pass redundancy, compliance, and performance benchmarks.

items.question: Can I bring my own containers?
items.answer: Yes. Deploy any Docker image via our registry proxy or attach prebuilt ML frameworks with secrets, datasets, and accelerators.

items.question: What happens if a provider goes offline?
items.answer: Fleet policies automatically migrate workloads to backup providers. You are never billed for failed runs and can enforce redundancy.

examples.title: Python SDK
examples.code:
from zetacube import Client

client = Client(api_key="your_api_key")

# Launch H100 GPU instance
instance = client.launch(
    gpu="h100",
    image="pytorch/pytorch:latest",
    command="python train.py"
)

print(f"Instance ID: {instance.id}")
print(f"Status: {instance.status}")

examples.title: REST API
examples.code:
curl -X POST https://api.zetacube.com/v1/instances \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "gpu": "h100",
    "image": "pytorch/pytorch:latest",
    "command": "python train.py"
  }'

company.heroDescription: We're building the future of distributed GPU computing. Our mission is to make high-performance compute accessible, affordable, and reliable for everyone.
storyParagraphs: ZetaCube was founded in 2023 by a team of cloud infrastructure veterans who experienced firsthand the challenges of accessing affordable GPU compute. We saw researchers waiting weeks for GPU allocations, startups burning through runway on cloud bills, and data centers with idle capacity unable to monetize their infrastructure.

Our platform connects these dots—creating a global marketplace where anyone can access high-performance GPUs instantly, while providers earn revenue from their existing infrastructure. Today, we serve thousands of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide.
